name: M-X-01 PaperFeatureEnabled off skips Paper entirely
description: Legacy-only diagnostic switch. PaperFeatureEnabled is read once at Awake, so flipping it needs a restart to take effect — not an automated-suite setConfig check.

steps.message: Set 11 UI-NotSynced/PaperFeatureEnabled to false in the config file, then restart the game. Confirm: no Piece of Paper in the crafting list, no Paper tab on any item, no paper-related error in the log on load. Then set it back to true and restart again to confirm Paper returns. Mark Fail if either half didn't hold.
